title: Honorable Mention at ASSETS 2026
body: Our full paper "From Notification to Completion: Rethinking Reminder Systems for People Living with Dementia" was accepted at ACM ASSETS 2026 in Portugal and received an Honorable Mention award.

title: Lead-author poster at CSCW 2026
body: My poster "Used By, Not Used On: An Adaptive Systems Framework to Design Technology for and with People with Dementia" was accepted at ACM CSCW 2026 in Salt Lake City.

title: Newark Wonder final showcase
body: As a technical mentor on the NJIT team, collaborated with high school teams from the Newark School of Data Science & IT who built an accessible planning and navigation app with and for New Jersey Regional Day School students, presented at the final showcase.

title: Reviewing for CSCW 2026
body: Served as a peer reviewer for the ACM CSCW 2026 Poster Track.

title: Started my Ph.D. at NJIT
body: Joined the Information Systems Ph.D. program at New Jersey Institute of Technology as an NSF-funded research assistant, studying assistive technology for aging and cognitive change.
